fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political commentary on Dade County representation in Tallahassee, upcoming city elections and commission races, and debate over forming a separate county for Miami Beach. Coverage also addresses public welfare fundraising claims, city administration and the selection of a new city manager, transportation and route changes for Miami Beach jitneys, and civic infrastructure topics including bridges and causeways. Additional items discuss prohibition enforcement and alleged bootleg liquor, local business and real estate conditions (including used-car shipments), utilities and municipal services, and community organizations such as the American Legion and Girl Scouts, alongside society and entertainment notes.
